person.name: Tanko Shekwonuzayi Glory
person.description:
As History students, we spend our days studying people, their stories, and the footprints they leave behind. But today, we turn the spotlight on one of our own.

This month, we celebrate Shekwonuzayi Tanko Glory, fondly known as "Diplomat" a course mate whose presence adds its own flavour to our class community.

Beyond the lectures, assignments, and all the academic wahala 🤧, we appreciate having you as part of this journey.

May your story be filled with remarkable achievements, beautiful opportunities, and milestones worth remembering.

Keep making history, Glory! May your dream of becoming a diplomat come true. And please, make sure you keep up with that your oyinbo accent too. 😅❤️
